case.title: Unsave from 'My saved news' removes item immediately

steps.targetDescription: Save target article from any section (ensure present in saved list)
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='news-card']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG') [data-testid='bookmark-icon']

steps.targetDescription: Saved state indicator on the card is visible
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='news-card']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG') [data-testid='bookmark-icon'][data-state='saved']

steps.assertion: Take the next step in your development at UKG

steps.targetDescription: Tap filled bookmark icon to unsave from list
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='saved-news-item']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG') [data-testid='bookmark-icon'][data-state='saved']

steps.targetDescription: Saved item disappears immediately from list
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='saved-news-item']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG')
